method: BASELINE. scope: Pension age (s 23(5A)-(5D)); qualifying residence (s 7(5)); age pension qualification and payability (ss 43(1)(a)-(c), 44(1)) with the ordinary income and assets tests of Pension Rate Calculator A (point 1064-A1 Steps 1-11, Modules E and G, Table G-1; figures in force as inputs, the 1064-E10 and Table G-2 reductions by their formulas); Commonwealth seniors health card (s 1061ZG, s 1071); disability support pension (ss 94(1), (2), (3A), (3B), (6), 103(2); the Impairment Tables rating as an input); jobseeker payment (s 593(1)) and the liquid assets test waiting period (ss 14A, 598); youth allowance for a full-time student (ss 540, 543-543B) and the parental income test (1067G-A1 Step 13, Module F); carer allowance for a disabled adult (ss 954, 954A, 957A, 23(14)); carer payment for a disabled adult (ss 197(1), 198(2)(a), (3)-(5), (7)); compensation recovery (s 17(1)-(3), (4A), (8) the income cut-out amount by its formula; ss 1166, 1167, 1169, 1170, 1173). From the seat of the claimant, for the three WA cradle-to-grave lives. Added 2026-10-24 (ssa-formulas.l4), from the sidecar's recovered formulas: the indexation factor and indexed amount (ss 1192(2), 1193, 1194) and the indexed pension assets value limits (s 1191 items 18-20, s 1203); deemed income of a member of a pensioner couple (s 1077); the youth allowance liquid assets test waiting period (ss 549A, 549C); the F28 total with a relevant sibling (points 1067G-F31(b), F35); the lump sum after repaid periodic compensation (s 17(4)).
seat: the claimant (the pensioner, the jobseeker, the person with a disability, the student, the carer): 'Am I qualified, and at what rate will I be paid?'
